run_kind: read-only calculated integration screens using normal validated Vehicle loads, reconciled CAD mass caches, and current source geometry
cad_cache_validation: All vehicle sources passed the standard loader with reconciled CAD caches. No cache was edited during analysis.
recovery_load_basis: 5 m/s nominal-opening screen; 20.4 m/s is the archived late-G80-delay off-nominal probe, not an approved delay. Constant deceleration over stated cord/canopy travel; opening shock factor remains an uncertainty.

soft_recovery_package.fabric_volume_unavailable_reason: The YAML contains whole-component estimated masses and soft envelope boxes, but no reliably measured textile/cord-only material masses or verified material densities; no rho-based solid-volume lower bound is supportable.
soft_recovery_package.packing_status: CAD envelope bounds only; actual fold, compression, knots, connectors, extraction force and repeatable packing have not been verified.

shared_avionics_package.rigid_check_limit: Nominal rigid BRep solids only; flexible wires, strain relief, connectors, switch shaft, bushing, panel, hand/tool access and assembly sequence are not modeled.
shared_avionics_package.switch_access_status: Open: switch envelope is internal and no sidewall opening, panel bushing, shaft projection, retention or tool/screwdriver envelope is modeled.
shared_avionics_package.battery_definition_note: Dedicated 1S 120 mAh LiPo envelope for the recovery controller; no connection to the flight-computer battery net.
shared_avionics_package.nose_insertion_direction: Soft recovery pack is proposed to enter from the removable nose toward the aft bulkhead; axial carrier electronics leave through the open aft end when the aft module is separated.
shared_avionics_package.insertion_access_status: Nominal rectangular-envelope radial clearances are positive. Flexible pack compression and the required carrier/cable extraction trajectory are not validated by these bounds.

opening_cases.basis: Constant deceleration over configured stopping distance plus gravity; no snap/opening-shock multiplier.

bulkhead_anchor.capacity_assessment: Anchor/washer ratings, G11 hole bearing and plate bending, bulkhead-to-tube bond/retention, opening shock and harness attachment strength are unavailable; calculated demands are not compared to invented allowables.

unresolved: Recovery battery, controller and switch have no resolved electrical ratings in the vehicle spec.
The active mode netlist must be checked for dedicated positive, switched-positive and return paths; a direct-main-battery edge does not provide an isolated supply.
Battery pulse-current/ESR, converter input current, output waveform, continuity load and connector ratings are unmeasured.

service_sequence: Keep both vehicle power systems unarmed and the recovery positive-line switch OFF. Disconnect/remove the dedicated recovery battery before handling the carrier; the recovery return conductor itself is direct and unswitched.
Separate the aft module at the modular joint for aft access. Keep the recovery output harness controlled; its flex path and strain relief are budget-only and not modeled.

Slide the recovery carrier axially through the open aft end only after its actual retention and connectors are released; replace the 1S battery with correct polarity and positive retention, then reconnect the isolated board and harness.
Repack the parachute/protection/harness from the nose opening toward the bulkhead. Preserve a clear path past the 61.6 mm nominal nose-shoulder bore and inspect anchor/washer seating.

After an aft-module swap, verify mechanical indexing, recovery harness/anchor engagement and electrical connections. Arm only after the external rotary-switch panel hole, bushing, retention and tool access are designed and physically checked; this CAD does not establish usable switch access.
open_items: Physical canopy/harness/protection packing, neck passage, extraction and repacking repeatability.
Anchor eye, washer, M3 strength, G11 hole bearing and bulkhead bending/bond/retention ratings and proof evidence.
External rotary switch shaft, panel hole/bushing, screw or nut retention, actuation/tool access and accidental-contact protection.
Cell connector, polarity protection, restraint, pulse current/voltage, controller consumption and complete manufacturer-approved ground test.
Carrier positive retention, board fasteners, connector clearance, wire bend radius, flex strain relief and routing around the avionics sled.
